claims.statement: Binary SHA-256 is part of the capability fingerprint, so replacing the executable invalidates a cached capability plan.
Supported launch flags are derived from bounded read-only probes instead of assuming all llama.cpp versions expose the same options.
The typed launch policy can express modern GPU-layer and CPU-MoE placement only when those options are certified for the exact executable.
